subject: Discovery recap + bake-off planning for Thumbprint Labs
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@thumbprint.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Discovery + next steps (Thumbprint evaluation)

Liam — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Key pain points you shared:
- Latency spikes on inference during peak batch processing (up to 850ms p50 for short prompts).
- High per-token cost when performing document-level reranking & embeddings at scale.
- Auditability: procurement needs clear logs and retention policy for regulatory review.

Goals we heard:
- Reduce average inference latency to under 300–350ms for the primary flow.
- Cut per-token inference cost by ~30% through batching/caching/quantization where feasible.
- Obtain SOC2 evidence and an auditable request log for the pilot environment.

Competitive context you mentioned: currently running an in-house endpoint and shortlisting two vendors (VectorLogic and Redwood). You asked for a focused bake-off that demonstrates latency, cost, and parity on embedding quality.

Proposed bake-off plan (high level):
1) Technical smoke tests (1–2 days): API parity & auth, sample inference runs with your test corpus.
2) Performance window (3 days): steady-state throughput measurements and p50/p95 latency at target QPS.
3) Cost analysis (concurrent with perf): token accounting and recommended config changes.
4) Security & compliance review: SOC2 artifacts, data retention settings, and KMS options.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Please share the RFP/pdf you mentioned and a representative sample of your test docs (anonymized) — I see procurement@ in CC, happy to share an upload link.
- Confirm decision criteria weightings (latency / cost / accuracy / security) — even rough percentages help prioritize tests.
- Target dates for vendor evaluation window (you suggested late Feb).

Attachments: we referenced a short checklist in the call, happy to upload a focused probe list once you confirm the decision weights.

Next steps:
- I'll send a bake-off probe workbook and a short instructions doc for your infra team to run baseline calls.
- If procurement wants NDAs or a vendor MSA, please send contact / DocuSign links and we'll expedite.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

— Avery
Avery Johnson
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@thumbprint.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@thumbprint.ai>, Procurement <procurement@thumbprint.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 16:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + next steps (Thumbprint evaluation)

Avery — great write-up, thanks. Quick clarifications and two items from our side:

Clarifications:
- Decision weighting (approx): latency 35%, cost 30%, accuracy 20%, security/compliance 15%.
- Target evaluation window: Feb 22–26 (we want vendor comparisons completed by end of week).

From us:
- Sharing RFP (attached): 'thumbprint_requirements_rfp.pdf' — contains SLO targets, sample schema, and compliance checklist.
- Test data sample (attached): small anonymized corpus for smoke tests ('thumbprint_test_data_sample.json').

Competitive context: VectorLogic already agreed to a baseline run the week prior; we want Redwood to run the same probe list so we can compare apples-to-apples. Key hard blockers for us are p95 latency under 700ms at 2x baseline QPS, and clear KMS/HSM key usage for encryption at rest.

Procurement note: procurement@ will engage on NDAs and an initial SOW. They prefer DocuSign for signature routing. Sanjay (cc) will coordinate technical ops and can provide access credentials for our staging cluster.

Happy to sync again if you need clarifications before Feb 22.

— Liam
Director of Product | Thumbprint Labs
liam.oconnor@thumbprint.ai | +1 (617) 555-0199

Attachments: thumbprint_requirements_rfp.pdf (16 pages), thumbprint_test_data_sample.json (4 MB)

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@thumbprint.ai>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@thumbprint.ai>, Procurement <procurement@thumbprint.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Recap: Discovery + next steps (Thumbprint evaluation) — prep for bake-off

Team — forwarding Liam's attachments. Summary of what I think we should run and owners below. I want to keep this lightweight but measurable:

Proposed Redwood probe list (will formalize into the workbook):
- Probe 1: API parity + auth (5 endpoints) — confirm headers, model versions, streaming behavior. (owner: Camila)
- Probe 2: Latency sweep — p50/p95 at 1x and 2x baseline QPS using their sample corpus. (owner: Avery)
- Probe 3: Embedding parity & rerank quality — compute embedding cosine drift vs. their baseline for 200 samples. (owner: Marissa)
- Probe 4: Cost sensitivity test — run with batching and quantized model variant and report per-token cost delta. (owner: Avery + Infra)
- Probe 5: Compliance check — provide SOC2 artifact links, describe KMS integration and retention policy. (owner: Camila)

Timeline (compressed):
- Feb 10: probe workbook and instructions to Thumbprint ops (I can deliver by EOD).
- Feb 22: scheduled smoke tests (we send sample curl + token).
- Feb 23–26: perf & cost windows.

Open questions we need answered from Thumbprint ASAP:
- Who will run the baseline scripts for VectorLogic? Do they share results or raw logs?
- Confirm any IP/data policies we must follow with their staging cluster.
- Procurement: NDA routing preference confirmed? (DocuSign is likely)

Attachments to prepare: I'll build 'redwood-bakeoff-probe-list.xlsx' (short checklist + expected metrics) and share the Drive link. Can Camila own SOC2/artifact collection and Marissa take the embedding evaluation?

— Avery

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@thumbprint.ai>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@thumbprint.ai>, Procurement <procurement@thumbprint.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Recap: Discovery + next steps (Thumbprint evaluation) — prep for bake-off

Thanks — I can take SOC2/artifact collection and confirm KMS details. Action items:
- Camila: collect SOC2 report, KMS/HSM spec, and write a one-page compliance summary (due Feb 18).
- Marissa: produce embedding evaluation plan + baseline metrics (due Feb 19).
- Avery: final probe workbook + curl examples and cost analysis template (due Feb 10).
- Marissa/Avery: coordinate with Infra to ensure quantized variant is reachable in staging (Marissa to ping infra).

I'll also ask Sanjay for the VectorLogic baseline logs; if they share, we can use them as a direct comparator. If not, we'll run identical workloads and request the raw logs for parity.

I'll start the compliance doc and share the Drive link when ready.

— Camila
